audit.whatIsWrong: Five rows contradicted their own whys: level 3 was Renekton against 'the lane sits even', levels 4-5 were Skill against 'his empowered stun combo keeps him ahead', level 6 was Renekton against 'Level 6 is even-leaning', first item was Skill against 'Renekton still stuns and bursts you at first item', and 2+ items was Renekton against a whys line describing Yone scaling past him.
audit.why: The packet chart and the already-audited mirror agree on rows 4-5 and first item going to Renekton and level 3 / level 6 being even. The mirror put the 2+ items row at Skill rather than Yone — Dominus still wins a straight brawl even once Yone's items are online — so that row is Skill on both pages.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Renekton / Renekton / Skill / Renekton / Skill / Renekton / Skill as matched full/content pairs, with ratings, the phases[].why lines and whys[6] rewritten to match.

audit.whatIsWrong: Slice and Dice was the ability the page told you to bait, with no cooldown given anywhere; Ruthless Predator likewise.
audit.why: Slice and Dice is 16/14.5/13/11.5/10s — long enough that its downtime is the whole window; Ruthless Predator is 16-8s and empowers above 50 Fury.
audit.corrected: 10-16s written onto Slice and Dice in spikes[0].text, spikes[3].text, late and phases[5].why.

audit.whatIsWrong: The single most important interaction in this lane was absent: empowered Ruthless Predator DESTROYS DAMAGE SHIELDS, which removes Spirit Cleave's shield outright, and it stuns for 1.5s rather than 0.75s. The page said only 'Empowered = long stun'. Two fields also credited Yone with sustain or healing ('your W sustain', 'your DPS and healing grind him down') — Spirit Cleave shields, Yone has no heal in his kit. Fate Sealed was again described as setting up knockups.
audit.why: Riot's W text states the shield destruction and both stun durations verbatim; the mirror recorded the same finding from the other side.
audit.corrected: Shield destruction and the 1.5s stun written into dosFull[0].d, report[5].t, dontsFull[1].d and spikes[0].text; Yone's 'sustain'/'healing' replaced with Spirit Cleave's 14s shield; the W auto-reset added as the burst tell; Fate Sealed restated as blink-behind-and-pull.

audit.why: Cull the Meek heals him and the heal doubles above 50 Fury, so Grievous Wounds genuinely decides extended trades here.
audit.corrected: report[8].t already calls for early Executioner's Calling and breakdown.late keeps anti-heal core — no edit needed.

edits.before: At two items your DPS, sustain and R outscale his front-loaded kit.
edits.after: At two items it evens — your DPS scales as his front-loaded kit flattens.

edits.before: Full kit online — your core pattern starts now. Keep the wave near your side so Renekton must walk into your engage range.
edits.after: Full kit online and it evens: his Q is 7s but Spirit Cleave covers a short trade. Fight only on an empty fury bar.

edits.before: The lane-control window: trade around Ruthless Predator's cooldown and bank small leads. If ahead, freeze and deny; if behind, farm safe.
edits.after: His window: an empowered stun combo beats every walk-up, and Cull the Meek heals him back. Farm safe and bank nothing risky.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge. Reassess every all-in at 6 — Renekton's ultimate changes the math too.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind him and pulls, it is not a knockup. Dominus adds health and an aura — don't R an even-HP Renekton.

edits.before: Blade of the Ruined King is your spike — force fights the moment it completes, on Ruthless Predator's cooldown.
edits.after: Blade of the Ruined King lands, but his empowered W still stuns and eats the shield — wait for his E to be spent.

edits.before: Two items on: your side-lane pattern is at full power. Renekton carry threat 8.5/10 — close before the map decides instead of you.
edits.after: Two items in it evens out: your pattern is online but Dominus still wins a straight brawl. Fight only with his E on cooldown.

edits.before: Fate Sealed sets up team knockups nothing can dodge — build your teamfight around that. Renekton carry threat: 8.5/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.
edits.after: Fate Sealed blinks behind their back line and pulls it to you — build your teamfight around that. Renekton carry threat: 8.5/10 — anti-heal stays core, shift to picks and wave control if he gets ahead.

edits.before: Empowered = long stun. Bait it. Only engage once it is down or baited.
edits.after: Empowered W stuns for 1.5s and destroys your Spirit Cleave shield.

edits.before: Renekton wastes Ruthless Predator (Stun) — commit the full pattern immediately.
edits.after: His W resets his auto — the wind-up is your cue to back off, not the cast.

edits.before: Burning it for tiny value leaves you naked for its full cooldown.
edits.after: Above 50 Fury his W triple-slashes, stuns 1.5s and eats the shield.

edits.before: Track Renekton's Ruthless Predator (Stun): Empowered = long stun. Bait it. When it is down — Q3-R him.
edits.after: Empowered Ruthless Predator stuns 1.5s and destroys damage shields — your Spirit Cleave goes with it.

edits.before: Renekton with full fury is terrifying: Ruthless Predator (W) stun plus double Cull the Meek (Q) shreds you, and Slice and Dice (E) gives him the gap-close you can't dodge. Never trade while his fury bar is high.
edits.after: Renekton with full fury is terrifying: above 50 Fury, Ruthless Predator (W) stuns 1.5s and destroys your Spirit Cleave shield, and Slice and Dice (E) closes the gap on 10-16s. Never trade while his fury bar is high.

edits.before: Once you're 2+ items Renekton falls off hard: your Spirit Cleave (W) sustain, Q3 mobility and R outscale his flat kit, and you win any fight where his E is on cooldown.
edits.after: Once you're 2+ items Renekton flattens out: Spirit Cleave's 14s shield, Q3 mobility and Fate Sealed match his flat kit, and you win any fight where his E is on its 10-16s.

edits.before: By two items the matchup inverts: Renekton's power is front-loaded and flat while your BORK/Kraken plus W sustain and R re-engage keep scaling. Bait his Slice and Dice, punish the cooldown, and take extended skirmishes where your DPS and healing grind him down.
edits.after: By two items it evens: Renekton's power is front-loaded and flat while your BORK/Kraken plus Spirit Cleave's 14s shield and R re-engage keep scaling. Bait Slice and Dice, punish its 10-16s cooldown, and take skirmishes where your DPS grinds him down.
